ownership_rationale: shadcn owns adding the official registry Dialog to the configured project while preserving its existing component variants.
pencil-dev owns creating the reusable design and its connected instance in the open Pencil document and exporting the PNG through Pencil MCP.
frontend-design owns the requested dashboard design strategy, including art direction, typography and hierarchy, without requiring implementation.
react-components-engineer owns reusable React component lifecycle cleanup and ref behavior, independently of any UI library.
react-spa-engineer owns integrating form validation, pending state and retry with the settings flow's SPA runtime state.
web-ui-reviewer owns a scoped read-only UX and accessibility assessment with findings and evidence limits.
agent-browser owns opening the rendered site, submitting its form and checking the requested visible terminal state.

pencil-dev owns the Pencil screen, frontend-design translates the accepted design into the web interface, shadcn owns its UI component integration, and agent-browser verifies the rendered browser result.
